result.title: This AI-powered satellite constellation could revolutionize Earth observation
result.description:
@Orbitworks-UAE plans to launch a 10-satellite constellation this year. Rather than capturing images in orbit and transmitting them back to Earth for analysis, the satellites will use #AI to process data in space. By identifying patterns and anomalies in real time, the satellites can enable immediate action.

Here, CEO Hamdullah Mohib explains how the technology works

By 2030, Earth observation technology could contribute $703 billion to global GDP.

result.title: Ghana just declared its first marine protected area
result.description:
Almost 200 countries across the world have pledged to protect 30% of their ocean by 2030. But right now, there’s a lot of work to do, with just 10% of the global ocean protected.

#Ghana just took a big step forward with the establishment of the Greater Cape Three Points marine protected area.

The ocean reserve will protect coastal ecosystems rich in biodiversity, and in turn support fish stocks so that communities of fishers can sustain their livelihoods.

Friends of Ocean Action is a group of leaders from business, science and civil society who use their knowledge to help conserve the #ocean and sustainably manage marine resources. Tap the link in our bio to learn more.

result.title: The Innovators Fighting Wildfires & AI Teacher Training in New York | WEF | Top Stories of the Week
result.description:
This week's top stories of the week include:

00:16 - Helping Ukraine medics fight burnout: War in #Ukraine is isolating doctors from one another, leading to burnout and self-doubt. Many physicians are working under immense pressure, cut off from colleagues they could lean on for support. This has had negative impacts on their mental health - and on patients. US firm Northwell Health has developed a countrywide #telehealth system that helps to bridge these gaps. Northwell Health Vice-President Eric Cioè-Peña explains how it works.

02:30 - This NY academy trains teachers in AI: A new, first-of-its-kind project - a partnership between the AFT and Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI - aims to reset the relationship between #AI and #schools. The National Academy for AI Instruction - a bricks and mortar establishment based in New York - will train around 1 in 10 teachers in the US over the next 5 years. Here, Randi Weingarten, President of the American Federation of Teachers, introduces it.

04:40 - 3 innovators fighting wildfires: Last year, wildfires burned an area the size of the EU. In the northern hemisphere, the fire season will soon be upon us - so how are innovators preparing? Here, Sean Triplett of Earth Fire Alliance, Osmar Bambini of Umgrauemeio and Felipe Borelli of Robotics Cats speak about the next generation of wildfire-fighting technologies.

07:13 - AI is making workplace coaching accessible: AI coaching is on the rise, broadening access to mentoring at work, so that people at every level of an organization can receive guidance, says Alexi Robichaux, CEO and Co-Founder of BetterUp. Alexi Robichaux was a guest on #MeetTheLeader, a World Economic Forum video podcast.

result.title: 400,000 teachers are being trained in AI. Starting in New York
result.description:
For many teachers, the advent of AI has been overwhelming. Now a new project - a partnership between the Aft and Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI - aims to reset the relationship between #AI and schools.

The National Academy for AI Instruction will train around 1 in 10 teachers in the US over the next 5 years.

A new World Economic Forum report explores the conditions required for responsible AI integration in education systems. Read Shaping the Future of Learning: Education Readiness for the Age of AI: https://www.weforum.org/publications/shaping-the-future-of-learning-education-readiness-for-the-age-of-ai/
